description: This file defines the ReadableCustomerOptionValue class, which extends CustomerOptionValueEntity and implements Serializable. It adds a description field with getter and setter methods to provide a more readable representation of customer option values.

classes.name: ReadableCustomerOptionValue
classes.description: A class extending CustomerOptionValueEntity that implements Serializable and includes a description field to enhance the readability of customer option values.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the customer option value.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of the customer option value.
